scope: NRL as a whole: football language, positions, team-list terminology, statistics, competition/match language and betting-market terminology used in NRL research. MAYHEM/site architecture terms are excluded and belong in the Site Master Glossary.
rules: Preserve the NRL term as encountered.
Expand abbreviations only when supported by an authoritative source.
Do not guess unresolved football, statistical or market terminology.
Flag context-dependent NRL terms as AMBIGUOUS.
Every verified NRL term may become a research target through synonyms, related statistics, roles, rules or source terminology.
Do not place MAYHEM architecture, audit-state or site-operation terminology in this glossary.

terms.plain_language: Average number of ball carries or hit-ups recorded per match in the relevant statistical source.
terms.research_use: Compare forward workload, role change and replacement-player usage.

terms.plain_language: Average metres gained from a player's kicks in the relevant statistical source.
terms.research_use: Assess field-position responsibility and changes in kicking role.

terms.plain_language: Average metres a player runs with the ball per match in the relevant statistical source.
terms.research_use: Compare workload, position-specific production and role continuity.

terms.plain_language: A backline position generally named inside the winger in an NRL team list.
terms.research_use: Target centre-specific availability, defensive combination, running and attacking-production evidence.

terms.plain_language: Average fantasy-game points recorded for a player by the relevant source.
terms.research_use: Use only as a secondary workload or production signal and compare it with component statistics.

terms.plain_language: One of the two primary halves positions in an NRL team list, commonly jersey number 6.
terms.research_use: Target playmaking, kicking, try-assist, line-break-assist and combination evidence.

terms.plain_language: A kick or play credited with forcing the defending side into a goal-line drop-out under the applicable rules or statistical definition.
terms.research_use: Assess repeat-set creation and kicking pressure for relevant playmakers.

terms.plain_language: The completed-match state after play has ended and a final result is available.
terms.research_use: Trigger result, scoring and post-match evidence research.

terms.plain_language: A backline position commonly listed at jersey number 1 in an NRL team list.
terms.research_use: Target running, support play, kick-return, try, line-break and positional-continuity evidence.

terms.plain_language: One of the two primary halves positions in an NRL team list, commonly jersey number 7.
terms.research_use: Target kicking responsibility, field position, try creation, repeat-set generation and halves-combination evidence.

terms.plain_language: A bookmaker market pricing each team simply to win the match.
terms.research_use: Acquire two-sided prices for implied-probability and market-movement research.

terms.plain_language: The central dummy-half position commonly listed at jersey number 9 in an NRL team list.
terms.research_use: Target distribution volume, tackles, ruck involvement, running and replacement-hooker evidence.

terms.plain_language: A player named on the match-day bench who can enter the game as part of the team's interchange rotation.
terms.research_use: Research bench composition, role coverage, rotation changes and replacement effects.

terms.plain_language: Near-match team news or official selection updates published after the initial team list.
terms.research_use: Search for withdrawals, positional changes, reduced squads and late availability information.

terms.plain_language: In betting context, the points handicap applied to a team; in football context, it can also refer to an attacking or defensive line.
terms.research_use: Disambiguate context before using the term in market or football analysis.

terms.plain_language: A recorded break through the defensive line under the source's statistical definition.
terms.research_use: Assess attacking penetration, especially for backs and edge players.

terms.plain_language: A recorded action credited with creating a teammate's line break.
terms.research_use: Assess playmaking and chance creation beyond tries and try assists.

terms.plain_language: A forward position commonly listed at jersey number 13 in an NRL team list.
terms.research_use: Target middle workload, passing involvement, tackles, running metres and role evidence.

terms.plain_language: A dataset or player record with relatively few observations, limiting confidence in broad conclusions.
terms.research_use: Trigger broader career, reserve-grade and role-context research while preserving uncertainty.

terms.plain_language: An implied win probability after removing the bookmaker margin from both sides of a two-team market.
terms.research_use: Create a cleaner market baseline for comparing prices across time or sources.

terms.plain_language: The amount by which bookmaker implied probabilities sum to more than 100 percent.
terms.research_use: Estimate bookmaker margin and normalize two-way prices.

terms.plain_language: Points scored minus points conceded across the specified set of matches.
terms.research_use: Compare season strength and recent scoring balance without relying only on win-loss record.

terms.plain_language: Metres gained after first defensive contact under the relevant source's statistical definition.
terms.research_use: Assess carry effectiveness and middle-forward contribution.

terms.plain_language: The period after a fixture has been completed.
terms.research_use: Research verified result, player output, tactical outcomes and injuries or incidents that occurred during the match.

terms.plain_language: A player named in a current squad who has not yet produced a completed NRL Premiership statistical sample.
terms.research_use: Search official lower-grade, junior, trial and team-list evidence without representing it as NRL production.

terms.plain_language: A middle-forward position commonly listed at jerseys 8 and 10 in an NRL team list.
terms.research_use: Target hit-ups, running metres, post-contact metres, tackles, minutes and rotation evidence.

terms.plain_language: Recorded occasions a player receives possession under the source's statistical definition.
terms.research_use: Assess distribution involvement and role volume, especially for spine players.

terms.plain_language: In team-list context, a player retained outside the primary match-day 17 or in an extended squad; exact status depends on the published team-list stage.
terms.research_use: Research the specific team-list stage before assuming the player is selected to play.

terms.plain_language: An edge-forward position commonly listed at jerseys 11 and 12 in an NRL team list.
terms.research_use: Target edge workload, defensive involvement, running, offloads and combination evidence.

terms.plain_language: The players named to begin the match in the starting 13.
terms.research_use: Compare initial team lists with later changes and final match-day selections.

terms.plain_language: A recorded occasion where the ball-carrier breaks or escapes a tackle under the source's statistical definition.
terms.research_use: Assess running threat and contact effectiveness.

terms.plain_language: In betting context, the bookmaker's combined-points line; elsewhere it may refer to a cumulative statistical total.
terms.research_use: Disambiguate before using it in market or statistical research.

terms.plain_language: A recorded action credited with directly creating a try under the source's statistical definition.
terms.research_use: Assess playmaking contribution and compare creators.

terms.plain_language: A team's performance separated by venue or home-and-away context.
terms.research_use: Research whether performance differs materially by location and whether the sample is sufficient.

terms.plain_language: An outside-back position commonly listed at jerseys 2 and 5 in an NRL team list.
terms.research_use: Target finishing, carries, kick returns, line breaks and defensive-edge combination evidence.
